msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Reproduce the EXACT product from the reference image: identical shape, proportions, materials, colours, stones and details; do not redesign it. Leave out any hands, price tags, stickers, shop text and the original background. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia my-scrap-place-16.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): Boutique campaign still life of a floral scrapbook mini album with ribbons, scissors and patterned paper from the reference. The product sits in the right third of the frame and the scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Warm natural light, soft textures. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen or collage. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia my-scrap-place-16.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of a floral handmade mini album from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEEEEA) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia my-scrap-place-25.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of jars of texture paste and stencils with geometric patterns, no labels from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEEEEA) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia my-scrap-place-11.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of scrapbooking tools: cutting mat, scoring board, scissors, bone folder and craft knife from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEEEEA) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia my-scrap-place-05.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo of four handmade greeting cards from the reference, centred and large in the frame on a seamless light (#EEEEEA) background with a soft shadow, crisp detail.
